import pytest

from stockroom.service import InventoryService


def make() -> InventoryService:
    svc = InventoryService()
    svc.register("A1", "bolt")
    svc.register("B2", "nut", "annex")
    return svc


def test_add_and_remove():
    svc = make()
    assert svc.add_stock("A1", 10) == 10
    assert svc.remove_stock("A1", 4) == 6
    assert svc.quantity("A1") == 6


def test_unknown_sku():
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        InventoryService().quantity("ZZ")


def test_location():
    svc = make()
    assert svc.location("A1") == "main"
    assert svc.location("B2") == "annex"


def test_low_stock():
    svc = make()
    svc.add_stock("A1", 1)
    svc.add_stock("B2", 9)
    assert svc.low_stock(5) == ["A1"]


def test_overdraw():
    svc = make()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        svc.remove_stock("A1", 1)

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

MIGRATIONS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "migrations"


def connect(path: str = ":memory:") -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open a database and apply every migration in file-name order."""
    con = sqlite3.connect(path)
    for script in sorted(MIGRATIONS.glob("*.sql")):
        con.executescript(script.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return con

# stockroom

Inventory service layer for the warehouse scanners (a synthetic project written for
half-life-bench). The database schema is built by applying the SQL files in migrations/
in name order.

Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`.

## Usage

    from stockroom import InventoryService
    svc = InventoryService()
    svc.register("A1", "bolt")
    svc.add_stock("A1", 10)

constraints.reason: Handheld scanners call these methods over RPC by name and argument position, and their firmware is updated only twice a year.
constraints.text: Do not rename or remove any public method of InventoryService in stockroom/service.py, and do not change their signatures.

constraints.reason: Production databases have already applied them, so edits would never reach production and fresh installs would drift away from it.
constraints.text: Never modify or delete the existing migration files migrations/001_init.sql and migrations/002_add_location.sql.
